facts.text_en: Spence produced 254,795 tonnes of fine copper in 2025 and 255,586 tonnes in 2024; its first year with reported production is 2006 (Cochilco, Chilean copper mine production by company).
facts.text_es: Spence produjo 254.795 toneladas de cobre fino en 2025 y 255.586 toneladas en 2024; su primer ano con produccion reportada es 2006 (Cochilco, produccion chilena de cobre de mina por empresa).
